question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 4: punishment".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term** "punishment" **fits perfectly in the sentence, suggesting that Munoo feels that the man on the steel horse caused him some form of distress or punishment.
 
• A** noun is required** to fit grammatically in the given sentence structure as it is referring to a consequence (punishment) experienced by Munoo caused by the fellow on the steel horse.
 
• It also creates a logical narrative context with Munoo feeling resentful and disheartened, suggesting an adverse experience or "punishment".

Therefore, the **correct answer** is **"Option 4: punishment".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Have punished"**, **"be punished"**, and** "having punish"** are all verb forms, and they would not fit the sentence contextually or grammatically as a noun is needed after "his".
 
• Furthermore, these three options would change the tense of the sentence which would disrupt its coherence with the subsequent text.
